reason: Thirty-six dollars for a lip balm is a lot on my fixed income. I don't wear much color anymore, and a plain balm from the drugstore or Ulta takes care of my cracked winter lips just fine.
objection: I've never heard of this brand, there are no reviews, and it's only sold through Facebook ads. I buy from names I know at the store where I can see and try it, and I'm not paying $36 to gamble on a little pink tint I don't need.
would_change_my_mind: If it were sold at Ulta or a department store counter where I could try it, and my friends or real reviews said it truly healed dry, cracked lips better than my usual balm.
